ios.desc:
Hate typing the same thing over and over on your iPhone? WordBoard is a custom keyboard that lets you copy, paste, and insert text snippets instantly so you can type faster everywhere.
Save phrases, quick replies, contact details, hashtags, templates, or entire messages and insert them directly from your keyboard in any app. One tap. Done.

Featured in Best Apps for iOS 26 — Apple

FOR FAST TYPING ON IPHONE 
Stop switching between Notes and your keyboard. WordBoard keeps your most used text always one tap away so you can reply faster, stay consistent, and avoid mistakes.

ONE KEY FOR COPY AND PASTE 
Create keys that instantly insert:
* Common phrases and responses
* Email addresses and phone numbers
* Business details and links
* Customer support replies
* Hashtags and captions
* Text snippets and templates
* Your favorite images & GIFs

Power users save dozens of snippets and never retype the same thing again.

KAOMOJI & EMOTICONS 
Browse and insert hundreds of kaomoji and emoticons directly from your keyboard. No copy-pasting from other apps.

IMAGES & GIFS
Save and insert images and GIFs directly from your keyboard. Perfect for reaction images, logos, signatures, or anything you send repeatedly.

SMART TEMPLATES AND VARIABLES 
Use dynamic placeholders like {{ DATE }} or {{ CLIPBOARD }} and WordBoard automatically fills them in when you paste your text.

AI KEYS
On Apple Intelligence compatible devices, WordBoard can rewrite, translate, and transform text directly from your keyboard.

FOLDERS AND ORGANIZATION
Organize your snippets into folders for work, personal use, social media, or customer support so everything is easy to find while typing.

WORKS IN EVERY APP
WordBoard works anywhere the iOS keyboard works, including Messages, Mail, WhatsApp, Instagram, Slack, Notes, and more. Switch instantly between the standard keyboard and WordBoard while typing.

WHAT CUSTOMERS ARE SAYING 
This is such a practical keyboard for those that constantly use the same wording. Formatting stays intact and it saves so much time.
So convenient. I used to copy and paste from Notes all day. Now everything is one tap.
Best shortcut keyboard ever. If you repeat phrases, this is the fastest way to type on iPhone.

SAVE TIME. TYPE FASTER.
WordBoard is the fastest way to copy, paste, and insert text snippets on iPhone and iPad.
Start with 6 free keys or upgrade to Pro for unlimited keys, hashtag imports, and contact info integration.
